records.action: Supply the actual legal seller name, business type/registration status and registration number if applicable. Approval of procedures does not supply these unknown facts.
Provide appropriately reviewed consumer-rights/remedy wording. Existing rights-preservation statements and approved return procedures remain; no legal review is inferred from general approval.
Verify the actual courier attempt limit, redelivery availability and failed-delivery/returned-parcel charges. Contact-before-reshipping and disclosed/accepted additional charges are already approved.
Identify the verified legal party responsible for personal information after the actual legal seller is supplied.

Deployment operator verifies actual Vercel/Render/Supabase/Cloudinary account regions, administrative access, transfers and service arrangements; approve the accurate resulting disclosure. Do not guess locations.

Choose category-specific retention periods and verify feasible deletion/anonymization, log and backup-expiration treatment. Necessity/required-record principles and the manual request process are already approved.

Supply tax registration status and inclusive-pricing treatment; approve actual coupon eligibility, expiry, usage and stacking terms after inspecting supported controls. Price-error consent and merchandise-only discounts are already approved.

Verify actual courier COD collection evidence/settlement, authorized reconciliation, failed-payment handling and any eligibility restrictions. COD/pending-until-verified principles are already approved; do not invent an operational settlement process.
Confirm permissions/rights for the brand, website assets, product images and supplier descriptions and approve appropriate use terms. A reachable image URL is not permission.
Provide appropriately reviewed liability wording preserving mandatory consumer rights; no blanket exclusion is approved.
Provide appropriately reviewed governing-law and dispute-resolution wording based on the actual business.

Complete final policy/legal review and supply the intended effective date; record publication/last-updated dates only for actual approved publication. Update/notification procedures are already approved.
Complete verified legal seller identity and review the implemented contact/identity disclosures. Existing supplied contacts need no repeated approval; a complete sign-off is still unearned.
Complete outstanding facts/legal sections and dates, then obtain approval of the finished six pages. Approval of proposed procedures is recorded but does not finalize unresolved policy text.

Review the genuine records against actual SKU/variant/description/claim/image-right/price/stock/fulfilment evidence in CATALOG_APPROVAL_REVIEW.md. No production catalog change or automatic approval is authorized.
Complete local security/inventory/idempotency/session/abuse/COD controls and independent runtime/credential/schema/hosted verification. No successful local test alone earns the full sign-off.
